cnd19:2.1: dvāhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissanti so brāhmaṇo dvikkhattuṃ buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi,
cnd19:2.2: tassa bhagavā pañhaṃ puṭṭho na byākāsi
cnd19:2.8: saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ hiridhanaṃ ottappadhanaṃ sutadhanaṃ cāgadhanaṃ paññādhanaṃ satipaṭṭhānadhanaṃ sammappadhānadhanaṃ iddhipādadhanaṃ indriyadhanaṃ baladhanaṃ bojjhaṅgadhanaṃ maggadhanaṃ phaladhanaṃ, nibbānadhanaṃ
cnd19:2.9: imehi anekavidhehi dhanaratanehi aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavātipi sakko.
cnd19:2.10: athavā pahū visavī alamatto sūro vīro vikkanto abhīru acchambhī anutrāsi apalāyī pahīnabhayabheravo vigatalomahaṃsotipi sakko.
cnd19:2.11: dvāhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissanti dvāhaṃ sakkaṃ apucchissaṃ ayācissaṃ ajjhesissaṃ pasādayissanti
cnd19:4.2: ‘na me byākāsī’ti na me byākāsi, na ācikkhi, na desesi, na paññapesi, na paṭṭhapesi, na vivari, na vibhaji, na uttānī akāsi, na pakāsesi.
cnd19:4.4: maṃsacakkhunāpi cakkhumā, dibbacakkhunāpi cakkhumā, paññācakkhunāpi cakkhumā, buddhacakkhunāpi cakkhumā, samantacakkhunāpi cakkhumā.
cnd19:5.3: nīlo ca vaṇṇo pītako ca vaṇṇo lohitako ca vaṇṇo kaṇho ca vaṇṇo odāto ca vaṇṇo. akkhilomāni ca bhagavato
cnd19:5.4: yattha ca akkhilomāni patiṭṭhitāni taṃ nīlaṃ hoti sunīlaṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ ummāpupphasamānaṃ
cnd19:5.5: tassa parato pītakaṃ hoti supīkatakaṃ suvaṇṇavaṇṇaṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ kaṇikārapupphasamānaṃ,
cnd19:5.6: ubhato ca akkhikūṭāni bhagavatolohitakāni honti. sulohitakāni pāsādikāni dassaneyyāni indagopakasamānāni,
cnd19:5.7: majjhe kaṇhaṃ hoti sukaṇhaṃ alūkhaṃ siniddhaṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ addāriṭṭhakasamānaṃ,
cnd19:5.8: tassa parato odātaṃ hoti suodātaṃ setaṃ paṇḍaraṃ pāsādikaṃ dassaneyyaṃ osadhītārakāsamānaṃ,
cnd19:5.9: tena bhagavā pakatikena maṃsacakkhunā attabhāvapariyāpannena purimasucaritakammābhinibbattena samantā yojanaṃ passati divāce va rattiñca.
cnd19:5.10: yadāhi caturaṅgasamannāgato andhakāro hoti, suriyo ca atthaṃ gato hoti
cnd19:5.11: kāḷapakkho ca uposatho hoti, tibbo ca vanasaṇḍo hoti, mahā ca kāḷamegho abbhuṭṭhito hoti.
cnd19:5.12: evarūpe caturaṅgasamannāgate andhakāre samantā yojanaṃ passati.
cnd19:6.2: bhagavā dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe
cnd19:6.4: ime vata bhonto sattā kāyaduccaritena samannāgatā vacīduccaritena samannāgatā mano duccaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ upavādakā micchādiṭṭhikā micchādiṭṭhikammasamādānā te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ uppannā.
cnd19:6.5: ime vā pana bhonto sattā kāyasucaritena samannāgatā vacīsucaritena samannāgatā manosucaritena samannāgatā ariyānaṃ anupavādakā sammādiṭṭhikā sammādiṭṭhi kammasamādānā te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapannāti.
cnd19:6.6: iti dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passati cavamāne uppajjamāne hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāti,
cnd19:6.7: ākaṅkhamāno ca bhagavā ekampi lokadhātuṃ passeyya, dvepi lokadhātuyo, passeyya tissopi lokadhātuyo passeyya, catassopi lokadhātuyo passeyya, pañcapi lokadhātuyo passeyya, dasapi lokadhātuyo passeyya, vīsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, tiṃsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, cattālīsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, paññāsampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, satampi lokadhātuyo passeyya, sahassimpi cūlanikaṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, dvisahassimpi majjhimikaṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, tisahassampi mahāsahassiṃ lokadhātuṃ passeyya, yāvatā pana ākaṅkheyya tāvatakaṃ passeyya,
cnd19:7.2: bhagavā mahāpañño puthupañño hāsapañño javanapañño. tikkhapañño nibbedhikapañño paññāppabhedakusalo pabhinnañāṇo adhigatapaṭisambhido. catuvesārajjappatto dasabaladhārī purisāsabho purisasīho purisanāgo purisājañño purisadhorayho anantañāṇo anantatejo anantayaso aḍḍho mahaddhano dhanavā netā vinetā anunetā paññāpetā nijjhāpetā pekkhetā pasādetā.
cnd19:7.3: so hi bhagavā anuppannassa maggassa uppādetā, asañjātassa, maggassa sañjanetā, anakkhātassa maggassa akkhātā, maggaññū maggavidū maggakovido maggānugā ca pana etarahi sāvakā viharanti pacchā samannāgatā.
cnd19:8.1: so hi bhagavā jānaṃ jānāti, passaṃ passati, cakkhubhūto ñāṇabhūto dhammabhūto brahmabhūto vattā pavattā atthassa ninnetā, amatassa dātā dhammassāmi tathāgato,
cnd19:8.2: natthi tassa bhagavato aññātaṃ adiṭṭhaṃ aviditaṃ asacchikataṃ aphassitaṃ paññāya,
cnd19:8.3: atītaṃ anāgataṃ paccuppannaṃ upādāya sabbe dhammā sabbākārena buddhassa bhagavato ñāṇamukhe āpāthaṃ āgacchanti.
cnd19:8.4: yaṃ kiñci neyyaṃ nāma atthi dhammaṃ jānitabbaṃ attattho vā parattho vā ubhayattho vā diṭṭhadhammiko vā attho samparāyiko vā attho, uttāno vā attho, gambhīro vā attho, gūḷho vā attho, paṭicchanno vā attho, neyyo vā attho, nīto vā attho, anavajjo vā attho, nikkileso vā attho, vodāno vā attho, paramattho vā attho. sabbaṃ taṃ antobuddhañāṇe parivattati,
cnd19:9.1: sabbaṃ kāyakammaṃ buddhassa bhagavato ñāṇānuparivatti sabbaṃ vacīkammaṃ ñāṇānuparivatti, sabbaṃ manokammaṃ ñāṇānuparivatti,
cnd19:9.2: atīte buddhassa bhagavato appaṭihataṃ ñāṇaṃ, anāgate appaṭihataṃ ñāṇaṃ, paccuppanne appaṭihataṃ ñāṇaṃ, yāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ tāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ, yāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ tāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ,
cnd19:9.3: neyyapariyantikaṃ ñāṇaṃ, ñāṇapariyantikaṃ neyyaṃ, neyyaṃ atikkamitvā ñāṇaṃ nappavattati. ñāṇaṃ atikkamitvā neyyapatho natthi,
cnd19:9.5: yatā dvinnaṃ samuggapaṭalānaṃ sammā phassitānaṃ. heṭṭhimaṃ samuggapaṭalaṃ uparimaṃ nātivattati, uparimaṃ samuggapaṭalaṃ heṭṭhimaṃ nātivattati, aññamaññapariyantaṭṭhāyino te.
cnd19:9.6: evameva buddhassa bhagavato neyyañca ñāṇañca aññamaññapariyantaṭṭhāyino.
cnd19:9.7: yāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ tāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ, yāvatakaṃ ñāṇaṃ tāvatakaṃ neyyaṃ, neyyapariyantikaṃ ñāṇaṃ, ñāṇapariyantikaṃ neyyaṃ,
cnd19:9.8: neyyaṃ atikkamitvā ñāṇaṃ nappavattati, ñāṇaṃ atikkamitvā neyyapatho natthi,
cnd19:10.2: sabbe dhammā buddhassa bhagavato āvajjanapaṭibaddhā ākaṅkhāpaṭibaddhā manasikārapaṭibaddhā cittuppādapaṭibaddhā
cnd19:10.4: sabbesaṃ ca sattānaṃ bhagavā āsayaṃ jānāti, anusayaṃ jānāti, caritaṃ jānāti, adhimuttiṃ jānāti, apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye bhabbābhabbe satte jānāti.
cnd19:10.5: sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā antobuddhañāṇe parivattati.
cnd19:11.1: yathā ye keci macchakacchapā antamaso timitimiṅgalaṃ upādāya anto mahāsamudde parivattanti. evameva sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussā anto buddhañāṇe parivattati.
cnd19:12.1: yathā ye keci pakkhī antamaso garuḷaṃ venateyyaṃ upādāya ākāsassa padese parivattanti. evameva yepi te. sāriputtasamā paññāya samannāgatā, tepi buddhañāṇassa padese parivattanti.
cnd19:12.2: buddhañāṇaṃ devamanussānaṃ paññaṃ pharitvā abhibhavitvā tiṭṭhati.
cnd19:13.1: yepi te khattiya paṇḍitā brāhmaṇapaṇḍitā gahapatipaṇḍitā samaṇapaṇḍitā nipuṇā ka parappavādā vālavedhirūpā vobhindantā maññe caranti paññāgatena diṭṭhigatāni. te pañhe abhisaṅkharitvā abhisaṅkharitvā tathāgataṃ upasaṅkamitvā pucchanti gūḷhāni ca paṭicchannāni ca
cnd19:13.2: kathitā vissajjitāva. te pañhā bhagavatā honti niddiṭṭhakāraṇā.
cnd19:14.2: bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ olokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
cnd19:14.3: seyyathāpi nāma uppaliniyaṃ vā paduminiyaṃ vā puṇḍarīkiniyaṃ vā appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakānuggatāni antonimuggaposīni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni samodakaṃ ṭhitāni, appekaccāni uppalāni vā padumāni vā puṇḍarīkāni vā udake jātāni udake saṃvaddhāni udakā accugamma tiṭṭhanti anupalittāni udakena.
cnd19:14.4: evameva bhagavā buddhacakkhunā lokaṃ olokento addasa satte apparajakkhe mahārajakkhe tikkhindriye mudindriye svākāre dvākāre suviññāpaye duviññāpaye appekacce paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante, appekacce na paralokavajjabhayadassāvino viharante.
cnd19:14.6: ayaṃ puggalo rāgacarito ayaṃ dosacarito ayaṃ mohacarito, ayaṃ vitakkacarito ayaṃ saddhācarito ayaṃ ñāṇacaritoti.
cnd19:14.9: mohacaritaṃ bhagavā puggalaṃ uddese paripucchāya kālena dhammasavane kālena dhammasākacchāya garusaṃvāse niveseti,
cnd19:14.11: saddhācaritassa bhagavā puggalassa pasādanīyaṃ nimittaṃ ācikkhati buddhasubodhiṃ dhammasudhammataṃ saṅghasuppaṭipattiṃ sīlāni ca
cnd19:14.12: attano. ñāṇacaritassa bhagavā puggalassa vipassanānimittaṃ ācikkhati aniccākāraṃ dukkhākāraṃ anattākāraṃ.
cnd19:17.3: bhagavā sabbaññutañāṇena upeto samupeto upāgato samupāgato uppanno sampanno samannāgato.
cnd19:20.1: yāvatatiyañca devīsi byākarotīti mesutanti: yāva tatiyaṃ buddho sahadhammikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho byākaroti no saṃsāretīti
cnd19:20.2: evaṃ mayā uggahītaṃ, evaṃ mayā upadhāritaṃ, evaṃ mayā upalakkhitaṃ.
cnd19:20.3: devīsīti: bhagavā devo ceva isi cāti
cnd19:20.5: yathā rājapabbajitā vuccanti rājisayo, brāhmaṇapabbajitā vuccanti brāhmaṇisayo, evameva bhagavā devo ceva isi cāti
cnd19:21.2: mahantaṃ sīlakkhandhaṃ esi gavesi pariyesī tipi isi,
cnd19:21.6: mahantaṃ vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhaṃ esi gavesi pariyesītipi isi,
cnd19:21.7: mahato tamokāyassa padāḷanaṃ esi gavesi pariyesītipi isi,
cnd19:21.8: mahato vipallāsassa pabhedanaṃ esi gavesi pariyesītipi isi,
cnd19:21.18: mahato dhammadhajassa ussāpanaṃ esi gavesi pariyesītipi isi.
cnd19:21.25: mahantaṃ paramatthaṃ amataṃ nibbānaṃ esi gavesi pariyesītipi isi.
cnd19:21.27: kahaṃ buddho kahaṃ bhagavā kahaṃ devadevo kahaṃ narāsabhotipi isīti
cnd19:21.28: yāva tatiyañca devīsi byākarotīti me sutaṃ.’
cnd19:24.3: ‘paro loko’ti manussalokaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbo paro loko’ti
cnd19:25.1: brahmaloko sadevakoti-sadevako loko samārako sabrahmako sassamaṇabrāhmaṇī pajā sadevamanussāti
cnd19:26.1: diṭṭhiṃ te nābhijanātīti-tuyhaṃ diṭṭhiṃ khantiṃ ruciṃ laddhiṃ ajjhāsayaṃ adhippāyaṃ loko na jānāti:
cnd19:26.2: ‘ayaṃ evaṃdiṭṭhiko evaṃkhantiko evaṃruciko evaṃladdhiko evaṃajjhāsayo evaṃadhippāyo’ti na jānāti na passati na dakkhati nādhigacchati na vindati na paṭilabhatīti
cnd19:27.2: athavā bhagavā sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānantipi yasassīti
cnd19:30.1: evaṃ abhikkantadassāvinti: evaṃ abhikkantadassāviṃ aggadassāviṃ seṭṭhadassāviṃ viseṭṭhadassāviṃ pāmokkhadassāviṃ uttamadassāviṃ paramadassāvinti
cnd19:32.1: kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantanti: kathaṃ lokaṃ avekkhantaṃ paccavekkhantaṃ tulayantaṃ tīrayantaṃ vibhāvayantaṃ vibhūtaṃ karontanti.
cnd19:33.1: maccurājā na passatīti: maccurājā na passati na dakkhati nādhigacchati na vindati na paṭilabhatīti
cnd19:36.2: ‘loko’ti-nirayaloko tiracchānaloko pettivisayaloko manussaloko devaloko khandhaloko dhātuloko āyatanaloko ayaṃ loko paro loko brahmaloko sadevako.
cnd19:36.5: kittāvatā nu kho bhante lokoti vuccatīti:
cnd19:36.6: lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā loko’ti vuccati.
cnd19:36.8: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu lujjati, rūpā lujjanti, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ lujjati, cakkhusamphasso lujjati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi lujjati,
cnd19:36.12: mano lujjati, dhammā lujjanti, manoviññāṇaṃ lujjati, manosamphasso lujjati, yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati, vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi lujjati,
cnd19:36.13: lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā loko’ti vuccatīti.
cnd19:37.1: suññato lokaṃ avekkhassūti: dvīhi kāraṇehi suññato lokaṃ avekkhati:
cnd19:37.3: kathaṃ avasiya pavattasallakkhaṇavasena suññato lokaṃ avekkhati:
cnd19:37.4: rūpe vaso na labbhati, vedanāya vaso na labbhati, saññāya vaso na labbhati, saṅkhāresu vaso na labbhati, viññāṇe vaso na labbhati.
cnd19:37.7: rūpaṃ ca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca rūpe
cnd19:37.8: evaṃ rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
cnd19:37.9: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave rūpaṃ anattā, tasmā rūpaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati rūpe
cnd19:37.10: evaṃ me rūpaṃ hotu, evaṃ me rūpaṃ mā ahosī’ti.
cnd19:38.2: vedanā ca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ vedanā ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca vedanāya
cnd19:38.3: evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosīti.
cnd19:38.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave vedanā anattā, tasmā vedanā ābādhāya saṃvattati. na ca labbhati vedanāya
cnd19:38.5: evaṃ me vedanā hotu, evaṃ me vedanā mā ahosī’ti.
cnd19:39.2: saññā ca hidaṃ, bhikkhave attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ saññā ābādhā saṃvatteyya. labbhetha ca saññāya
cnd19:39.3: evaṃ me saññā hotu, evaṃ me saññā mā ahosī’ti,
cnd19:39.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave saññā anattā, tasmā saññā ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati saññāya
cnd19:39.5: evaṃ me saññā hotu, evaṃ me saññā mā ahosī’ti.
cnd19:40.2: saṅkhārā ca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissaṃsu nayidaṃ saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvatteyyuṃ, labbhetha ca saṃkhāresu
cnd19:40.3: evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṃkhārā mā ahesunti.
cnd19:40.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave saṅkhārā anattā, tasmā saṅkhārā ābādhāya saṃvattanti, na ca labbhati saṅkhāresu
cnd19:40.5: evaṃ me saṅkhārā hontu, evaṃ me saṅkhārā ahesunti.
cnd19:41.2: viññāṇaṃ ca hidaṃ bhikkhave attā abhavissa, nayidaṃ viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvatteyya, labbhetha ca viññāṇe
cnd19:41.3: evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti.
cnd19:41.4: yasmā ca kho bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ anattā, tasmā viññāṇaṃ ābādhāya saṃvattati, na ca labbhati viññāṇe
cnd19:41.5: evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ hotu, evaṃ me viññāṇaṃ mā ahosīti.
cnd19:42.1: kathaṃ tucchasaṅkhārasamanupassanāvasena suññato lokaṃ avekkhati: rūpe sāro na labbhati, vedanāya sāro na labbhati, saññāya sāro na labbhati, saṃkhāresu sāro na labbhati, viññāṇe sāro na labbhati. rūpaṃ asāraṃ nissāraṃ sārāpagataṃ niccasārasārena vā sukhasārasārena vā attasārasārena vā, niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā aviparināmadhammena vā. vedanā asārā nissārā sārāpagatā-saññā asārā nissārā sārāpagatā-saṃkhārā asārā nissārā sārāpagatā-viññāṇaṃ asāraṃ nissāraṃ sārāpagataṃ niccasārasārena vā sukhasārasārena vā attasārasārena vā niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā aviparināmadhammena vā. yathā pana naḷo asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā eraṇḍo asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā udumbaro asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā setavaccho asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā pāribhaddako asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā pheṇapiṇḍo asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā udakabubbuḷakaṃ asāraṃ nissāraṃ sārāpagataṃ, yathā marīci asārā nissārā sārāpagatā, yathā kadalikkhandho asāro nissāro sārāpagato, yathā māyā asārā nissārā sārāpagatā. evameva rūpaṃ asāraṃ nissāraṃ sārāpagataṃ, niccasārasārena vā sukhasārasārena vā attasāra sārena vā, niccena vā dhuvena vā sassatena vā
